integrity: The exact theorem and proof are included; numerical checks only corroborate finite samples. The originating classification and earlier torus-meridian studies are explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Relative dynamics only on the smooth invariant torus; no assertion of ambient normal multipliers or perturbation persistence. At \(a=1\) the limiting horn torus is singular; earlier equivalent publication cannot be absolutely excluded.
title: Two inequivalent infinite-period degenerations of four cubic torus cycles
